info.name: ERP System API
info.description:
Generated from docs/openapi.yaml by scripts/build-postman.js.

1. Import this collection and docs/postman/local.postman_environment.json, and pick the "ERP local" environment.
2. Run Auth > "Sign in; sets the session cookie". It saves {{token}}.
3. Every other request sends it as a Bearer token.

Change {{email}} in the environment to try another role (admin@, manager@, hr@, employee@erp.com).

item.name: Reorder plan - sales velocity, days of stock left, suggested quantity

request.name: Reorder plan - sales velocity, days of stock left, suggested quantity

description.content:
Roles - ADMIN, MANAGER.

`daily_velocity` = units sold in confirmed orders over the last `days`
days / `days`. `suggested_qty` = ceil(velocity x `cover` + reorder level
- quantity), at least 0. `status` is OUT (no stock), REORDER (below
reorder level, or runs out within `leadTime` days) or OK. Sorted OUT,
then REORDER, then by days of stock left.

item.name: Create an order - stock check, stock-out and order rows in one transaction

request.name: Create an order - stock check, stock-out and order rows in one transaction

description.content:
Roles - ADMIN, MANAGER. Product rows are locked in id order (so two
orders cannot deadlock), every line is checked against current stock,
and either the whole order is written - order, items, stock
movements `ORDER-<id>` - or nothing is. Prices are copied from the
product at this moment, so later price changes do not alter old orders.

item.name: Live updates - Server-Sent Events

request.name: Live updates - Server-Sent Events

description.content:
Roles - any signed-in user. Opened with `EventSource` in the browser
(the session cookie is sent) or any client that sends the Bearer
token. The connection stays open and receives:

- `event: ready` once, when the stream is open;
- `event: change` with `data: {"topic":"dashboard"}` after a
  successful write to products, categories, customers, orders or
  employees (a burst within 0.5 s is one event);
- a `: ping` comment every 25 s.

Events carry no business data: refetch the dashboard endpoints, which
apply the role rules. The stream ends when the session stops being
valid (logout-all, deactivation, role change, expiry). At most 5 open
streams per user. Single-instance: see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
